description: The official art the Daeva Card intro and the Find-your-Daeva panels show: one render per class and the NPC guide, hotlinked from the NCSOFT CDN (assets.playnccdn.com), never re-hosted, cropped or edited. A filled art entry is { url, alt, shows, foundOn, capturedOn }: the image address, its alt text, what it shows, the official page it was found on and the date. A pending entry shows no art on the page. Sources stay in this file, never on a page. The class list is the official class list (armory capture).

terms.reason: The NCSOFT fan content and AION 2 Creator Program terms could not be read from the build machine (its network policy refuses aion2.plaync.com and assets.playnccdn.com). Read them in a normal browser and record the link and the date here before any art entry below is filled in.
